paragraph: What do I have to do now that I'm **registered**? Please pay the bill at the first floor **register**. You can **register** for free and become a member.
english: formal recording
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا أفعل الآن بعد أن أصبحت عضواً؟

paragraph: This bus will take you to the **airport**. Can you all tell me how to get to the **airport**? How far is it to the **airport**?
english: a place where planes take off and land
arabicDesc: مثال: سيأخذك هذا الباص إلى المطار.

paragraph: The family is the most **basic** unit of society. Don't fail to learn these **basic** words by heart. What are the **basic** rules for keeping a dog?
english: necessary, essential for life or some process

paragraph: **Effective** communication is key to success in any relationship. I know a very **effective** way to do that. What's the most **effective** way to learn a language?
english: having the power to produce a required effect or effects

paragraph: We love him for reasons we don't **fully** understand. He won the race easily without being **fully** extended. I don't **fully** understand what I'm supposed to do.
english: completely

paragraph: You should always think **highly** of your own teachers. He is considered to be a **highly** qualified employee. He made a speech **highly** appropriate to the occasion.
english: very; to a high degree

paragraph: **Mrs**. North is very proud of her children. **Mrs**. Wood is a very good cook. I see the Mr. and the **Mrs**.
english: title before a woman's name

paragraph: I want to ask you one last **favor**. I really need to ask you a **favor**. Could you do me a small **favor**?
english: kind or helpful deed
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أطلب منك خدمة أخيرة.

paragraph: She has made the same **mistake** as last time. You are not the first to make this **mistake**. It is clear that he has made a big **mistake**.
english: error — see also error
arabicDesc: مثال: ارتكبت نفس الخطأ مرّة أخرى.

paragraph: The plane was late because of the bad **weather**. Thanks to the bad **weather**, the game was canceled. Because of the bad **weather**, I didn't go.
english: state of the atmosphere
arabicDesc: مثال: تأخرت الطائرة بسبب الطقس السيء.

paragraph: This video will walk you through creating your **profile**. I think I should probably change my **profile** picture. All the photos were posted on her Twitter **profile**.
english: the outermost shape, view, or edge of an object

other.meaning: shape, view, or shadow of a person's head from the side
summary or collection of information, especially about a person

paragraph: Try out other words to express the same **concept**. I find the **concept** of this site really good. Children don't have a **concept** of good and evil.
english: an abstract and general idea

paragraph: The town **square** becomes a market once a week. Can you tell me the way to the **square**? We need a **square** table, not a round one.
english: a polygon with four straight sides of equal length and four right angles

paragraph: I want to become a **citizen**. I am an American **citizen**. We want to become **citizens**.
english: legal member of a state

paragraph: Many young men tend to **commit** the same errors. Bill did not **commit** the crime. He had to **commit** the whole message to memory.
english: to do (something bad); to perpetrate — see also perpetrate
arabicDesc: مثال: كثير من الشباب يميلون إلى ارتكاب الأخطاء نفسها.

paragraph: I also worked at a restaurant in the **evening**. In the **evening**, someone knocked suddenly at the door. What are you going to do this **evening**?
english: time of day between the approximate time of midwinter dusk and midnight
arabicDesc: مثال: كنت أعمل أيضا في مطعم في المساء.

paragraph: What kind of **equipment** do we need to buy? What **equipment** do you need for your favorite sport? Please make sure that you check all the **equipment**.
english: whatever is used in equipping

paragraph: His mom let him have a lot of **freedom**. Do what you fear most, and you'll find **freedom**. The women of this country are fighting for **freedom**.
english: state of not being imprisoned or enslaved

paragraph: I've never been **sick** a day in my life. I'm **sick** of hearing the same thing all the time. Too much drinking will make you **sick**.
english: ill; not healthy
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أمرض يوما في حياتي.

paragraph: **Advice** isn't much good to me. I need money. I will keep your **advice** in mind. Without your **advice**, I would have failed.
english: opinion offered to guide behavior
arabicDesc: مثال: النصيحة ليست شيئًا ينفعني كثيرًا. أحتاج المال.

paragraph: His clothes are out of **fashion**. My friends know I have my own **fashion** sense. This type of camera is now out of **fashion**.
english: a current (constantly changing) trend, favored for frivolous rather than practical, logical, or intellectual reasons
arabicDesc: مثال: ثيابه لا تتماشى مع الموضة.

paragraph: The town is two miles away from the **coast**. She and I are going to the **coast** tomorrow. How far is it from here to the **coast**?
english: the edge of the land where it meets an ocean, sea, gulf, bay, or large lake

paragraph: It's as lovely as a **rose**. This **rose** is for you. There were no **roses** in the garden.
english: a shrub of the genus Rosa, with red, pink, white or yellow flowers

other.meaning: A number of places in the United States: (noun)

paragraph: This **conversation** is going to be recorded. Did you guys know the **conversation** was being recorded? I knew this **conversation** would last a long time.
english: expression and exchange of individual ideas through talking with other people

paragraph: Do you know what this **tool** is used for? A well designed schedule is a great organization **tool**. It's a surprise **tool** that will help us later.
english: any physical device meant to ease or do a task

paragraph: Am I less important than members of the **royal** family? We gave him a **royal** send-off at the airport. The **royal** family lives in the **Royal** House.
english: of or relating to a monarch or his (or her) family

paragraph: I am a little **stressed** right now. He feels a little bit **stressed**. Common causes of **stress** are work and human relationships.
english: (physics) internal force across a boundary per area

paragraph: The washing machine is **broken** again. The mirror has been **broken**. It's **broken**. What are we going to do now?
english: fragmented

paragraph: My **Christian** neighbors invited us to their holiday dinner.
english: a person who believes in Christianity; relating to Christianity

other.meaning: a person who believes in Christianity; relating to Christianity (adjective)

paragraph: Where they burn books, they will **eventually** burn people. We'll probably be able to figure this out **eventually**. I think I'll be able to do that **eventually**.
english: in the end

paragraph: Have you ever seen the mountains of our **holy** land? Coffee is the **holy** drink of university students. I swear on everything **holy** that I didn't do that.
english: dedicated to a religious purpose or a god

paragraph: Please walk faster, **otherwise** we risk missing the train. Look me in the eyes. **Otherwise**, it means nothing. Go directly to the airport. **Otherwise**, you'll be late.
english: differently, in another way
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خلاف ذلك، عكس ذلك

paragraph: We are **responsible** for your protection from now on. You should be **responsible** for your actions. You are **responsible** for what you do.
english: answerable for an act performed or for its consequences
arabicDesc: مثال: حمايتك هي مسؤوليتنا من الآن فصاعداً.

other.meaning: able to answer reasonably for one's conduct

paragraph: Can you save enough money for the down **payment**? I prefer **payment** in full to **payment** in part. He applied the money to the **payment** of debts.
english: the act of paying

paragraph: He is **fatter** than when I last saw him. All over the world, people are growing **fatter**. The more you eat, the **fatter** you'll get.
english: thick

other.meaning: A specialized animal tissue with high lipid content, used for long-term storage of energy: fat tissue (noun)

paragraph: A computer is a **complex** machine. The answer is more **complex** than you might think. What seems simple to you seems **complex** to me.
english: not simple or straightforward

paragraph: The government has taken measures to **promote** domestic industry. We must work hard to **promote** world peace. The government started a program to **promote** industry.
english: raise someone to a more important, responsible, or remunerative job or rank

other.meaning: advocate or urge on behalf of something

paragraph: It took me a while to find a **pair** of shoes that fit. I just bought a new **pair** of beach shorts. The two of them make a nice dancing **pair**.
english: two similar or identical things
arabicDesc: مثال: بحثت مطولا عن حذاء بمقاسي.

paragraph: He is what is called a **champion** of justice. France is the world **champion**! Way to go, France! He has the potential to become world **champion**.
english: someone who has been winner in a contest

paragraph: I saw him **tear** up the letter. The girl tried hard to hold back her **tears**. She **tore** the letter into pieces.
english: to rend (a solid material) by holding or restraining in two places and pulling apart, whether intentionally or not

other.meaning: A hole or break caused by tearing (noun)
A drop of clear, salty liquid produced from the eyes by crying or irritation (noun)

paragraph: The **enemy** kept up the attack all night. An **enemy** of an **enemy** is a friend. I'm not your **enemy**. I'm your friend.
english: someone who is hostile to, feels hatred towards, opposes the interests of, or intends injury to someone else
arabicDesc: مثال: داوم العدو على الهجوم طوال الليل.

other.meaning: of, relating to, or belonging to an enemy

paragraph: Each has his own **taste**. Try it and tell me what it **tastes** like. I have **tasted** everything good, but haven't found anything better than good health.
english: one of the sensations produced by the tongue

other.meaning: To sample the flavor of something orally (verb)

paragraph: He feels safe because he is under our **protection**. Which is more important, economic development or environmental **protection**? Nature provides other forms of **protection** against environmental dangers.
english: process of keeping something safe

paragraph: I can't drive because I don't have a **license**. She isn't old enough to get a driving **license**. You aren't supposed to go fishing without a **license**.
english: a legal document giving official permission to do something

paragraph: I'm strong enough to carry those heavy **metal** boxes. I only listen to heavy **metal** when I'm driving. Out of every **metal**, iron is the most useful.
english: chemical elements or alloys, their ores, and the mines where their ores come from

paragraph: Not everything on the web can be found through **Google**. Don't let **Google** give any medical advice to you. I **google** everyone that I interview for a job.
english: a particular Internet company
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس بإمكان جوجل أن يجد كل شيء على الإنترنت.

paragraph: I want to check the **status** of my order. Call me Monday morning to check on the **status**. The **status** of the project is as follows.
english: person’s position or standing

other.meaning: situation or state of affairs — see also state

paragraph: He **combined** two ideas into one. If we **combine** our efforts, we'll achieve our goal. It's not always easy to **combine** school and work.
english: to bring (two or more things or activities) together

paragraph: He stood with his finger in his **mouth**. Open your **mouth** and close your eyes. Can you keep your **mouth** shut?
english: the opening of a creature through which food is ingested — see also lip, face
arabicDesc: مثال: وقف و إصبعه في فمه.

paragraph: I don't care about **profit**. He sold his shares with a very good **profit**. Production is carried on for **profit**, not for use.
english: money you earn after paying costs

paragraph: In this case, I think he is **correct**. Please **correct** me when I make a mistake. I'm not sure if this is **correct**.
english: free from error
arabicDesc: مثال: في هذه الحالة، أعتقد أنه على حق.

other.meaning: To make something that was wrong become right (verb)

paragraph: Hope is not a **strategy**. I'm going to try a different **strategy** next time. This **strategy** is specific to that kind of operation.
english: science and art of military command

paragraph: This is a low-**budget** movie. The **budget** is extremely small. The project was finished on time and on **budget**.
english: the amount of money or resources earmarked for a particular institution, activity or timeframe

paragraph: We have a bit of a cash **flow** problem. We need to just go with the **flow**. I can't follow the **flow** of your thoughts.
english: movement in people or things characterized with a continuous motion, involving either a non solid mass or a multitude

other.meaning: To move as a fluid from one position to another (verb)

paragraph: His latest works are on **display** at the square. The author doesn't **display** much talent in his book. He never made a **display** of his learning.
english: a show or spectacle

paragraph: What's the difference between a **stream** and a river? A small **stream** winds its way through the fields. A **stream** of people came out of the theater.
english: a small river

other.meaning: any steady flow or succession of material
To flow in a continuous or steady manner, like a liquid (verb)

paragraph: Can you hear the noise of the **waves** on the beach? Our town is facing a **wave** of student protest. Suddenly a huge **wave** came and the boat disappeared.
english: moving disturbance, undulation
arabicDesc: مثال: أتسمع صوت الأمواج على الشاطئ؟

paragraph: My **aim** is to be a doctor. I know what his **aims** are. We **aim** to complete the project by next spring.
english: intention; purpose

paragraph: She usually goes to bed at **nine**. I work from **nine** to six. The plane arrived exactly at **nine**.
english: cardinal number
arabicDesc: مثال: عادة ما تخلد إلى السرير الساعة التاسعة.

paragraph: **Politics** is the art of the possible. Law and **politics** are two different things. Are you interested in **politics**?
english: a methodology and activities associated with running a government

paragraph: I have to give back the book before **Saturday**. Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and **Saturday**. I'm not going to school on **Saturday**.
english: day of the week
arabicDesc: مثال: عليّ أن أعيد الكتاب قبل السبت.

paragraph: We think, **therefore** we are. I think, **therefore** I am. I am because you are, and **therefore** we are.
english: consequently; by consequence — see also consequently, ergo, so, whence, thus

paragraph: No one ever **truly** knows what the future holds. What would make a date **truly** special for you? He turned out to be a **truly** special person.
english: really; sincerely

paragraph: This **flower** is more beautiful than that one. This is a beautiful **flower**, isn't it? What do you call this **flower**?
english: reproductive structure in angiosperms
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الوردة أجمل من تلك.

paragraph: I took his not coming to **indicate** that he wasn't interested. He seems much older than his age would **indicate**. **Indicate** size, color, and style on the order form.
english: to point out
arabicDesc: مثال: اعتبرتُ عدم قدومه كدليل أنه لم يكن مهتما بالأمر.

paragraph: The building is managed by a local arts **foundation**. Knowledge is the **foundation** and source of good writing. Lessons taught without fear lay the **foundation** for growth.
english: the act of founding, fixing, establishing, or beginning to erect

other.meaning: that upon which anything is founded

paragraph: A long time ago, there was a **bridge** here. Every religion is a **bridge** to the same place. I am taking pictures of the **bridge**.
english: construction or natural feature that spans a divide
arabicDesc: مثال: منذ زمن بعيد، كان هناك جسر هنا.

paragraph: Don't forget to **lock** up when you leave. Please **lock** the door when you leave. Never forget to **lock** the door.
english: something used for fastening
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس إقفال الأبواب عند مغادرتك.

paragraph: I don't know how to manage that large **estate**. The real **estate** man told lies to the couple. My father and mother have a large **estate** there.
english: the collective property and liabilities of someone, especially a deceased person

paragraph: The river is running **dry**. Cut, wash and **dry**, please. He tried to keep **dry** as best he could.
english: to become dry

paragraph: We **appreciate** everything you have done. Thanks a lot. I **appreciate** that. As always, I **appreciate** your time.
english: to be grateful for something

paragraph: If it's **cheap**, I'll buy it. I think I'll buy the **cheaper** one. Show me a **cheaper** one, please.
english: low and/or reduced in price

paragraph: That party was off the hook, **dude**! It isn't good to stay up all night, **dude**. You suck **dude**! I have to tell you everything!
english: an informal word for a man
arabicDesc: مثال: تلك الحفلة كانت مميزة، يا صاحِ!

paragraph: As soon as we sat down, she brought us **coffee**. He put salt into his cup of **coffee** by mistake. Do you guys have any real **coffee**?
english: a beverage made by infusing the beans of the coffee plant in hot water
arabicDesc: مثال: ما إن جلسنا حتى جاءت لنا بالقهوة.

paragraph: I thank you from the **bottom** of my heart. I live on the **bottom** floor. Sign at the **bottom**, please.
english: the lowest part of anything
arabicDesc: مثال: إني شاكر لك من أعماق قلبي.

paragraph: We were all present at her **wedding**. The **wedding** will take place next spring. It won't rain on my **wedding** day.
english: marriage ceremony

paragraph: Turn down the **volume**, please. Can you please reduce the **volume** of the music? The system is experiencing a high **volume** of calls.
english: strength of sound: how loud it is

other.meaning: single book of a publication issued in multi-book format, such as an encyclopedia

paragraph: I love the **smile** of your eyes. I love to see him **smile**. Face life with a **smile**!
english: to have a smile on one's face

paragraph: Do we **define** life, or does life **define** us? Who do you think you are to **define** my worth? In a word, how would you **define** technology?
english: to explain the meaning of a word; to state exactly

paragraph: This may prove to be an **advantage** after all. They did it without gaining an **advantage** from it. She gains an **advantage** over me in speaking Chinese.
english: any condition, circumstance, opportunity or means, particularly favorable or chance to success, or to any desired end

paragraph: Do you **object** to smoking? You mean you don't **object**? His main **object** in life was to become rich.
english: a thing that has physical existence but is not alive

other.meaning: 2. the goal, end or purpose of something

paragraph: Who would be its next **victim**? The **victim** declined to press charges. A man is always a **victim** of his truth.
english: one who is harmed

other.meaning: a living being slain and offered as a sacrifice

paragraph: The press **ban** on the case was removed yesterday. The **ban** is no longer taken seriously by anyone. He asked the officials to lift the **ban**.
english: to prohibit

paragraph: A few important facts emerged after the **investigation**. The **investigation** will go on for months. An **investigation** is going on.
english: the act of investigating
arabicDesc: مثال: ظهرت عدة حقائق مهمة بعد التحري.

paragraph: Good morning, I would like to **reserve** a room. Will you **reserve** a room for me for tomorrow? We **reserve** the right to refuse service to anyone.
english: a restriction

paragraph: He was standing at the **edge** of the dark. He was sitting on the **edge** of my bed. I was standing on the **edge** of the woods.
english: the outer part or line of something

paragraph: You must do your **duty**. I'm the **duty** nurse of this floor. If you need me, just call me. Have you finished your **duties**?
english: that which one is morally or legally obligated to do

paragraph: The **border** cuts across rivers. The forest **borders** the highway on two sides. How long is the wait at the **border** crossing?
english: the line or frontier area separating various territories

paragraph: My sister has a good **command** of both English and French. Your wishes are my **commands**. He gave me all the money at his **command**.
english: an order to do something
arabicDesc: مثال: أُختي لَديها سَيطَرَةٌ جَيدةٌ عَلى كُلِّ مِنَ الإنجليزيةِ و الفَرنسية

paragraph: **Switch** on the light. I can't see anything. Don't let him **switch** off the light. Did you **switch** off the computer?
english: a device to turn electric current on and off or direct its flow
arabicDesc: مثال: أشعل الضوء. لا يمكنني أن أرى شيئاً.

paragraph: I have to charge my **mobile** phone. How often do you have to charge your **mobile**? She hasn't got used to that **mobile** phone yet.
english: capable of being moved, especially on wheels

paragraph: My father never used to **engage** in such talk. I have no time to **engage** in political activity. He tried to **engage** me in the conversation.
english: to take part, or to attract someone's attention

paragraph: He doesn't have to go to the **institute** today. He was my best friend at the **institute**. What did the committee of the **institute** say?
english: an organization founded to promote a cause

paragraph: And when I woke up, I was **sad**. Don't look at me with such **sad** eyes. When every **sad** tone reminds me of you.
english: feeling sorrow

paragraph: It's a **quote** from the book. Can you **quote** me a price for the house? Our **quote** is the best effort we can make.
english: a statement attributed to someone

other.meaning: a summary of work to be done with a set price
a price set for a financial security or commodity

paragraph: I don't believe he is a **lawyer**. He pretended that he was a **lawyer**. He decided to be a **lawyer**.
english: professional person with a graduate law degree that qualifies for legal work

paragraph: You're going to need a bigger **boat**. Why didn't you tie the **boat** properly? You fell off of the **boat**.
english: water craft — see also watercraft, vessel, ship

paragraph: Your **reaction** wasn't surprising at all. That was just the **reaction** I was hoping for. **Reaction** is not always the best course of action.
english: action in response to an event
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن رد فعلك مفاجئًا على الإطلاق

paragraph: We have experienced many changes over the last **decade**. She has been married to him for a **decade** now. This story occurred more than a **decade** ago.
english: a group, set, or series of ten , particularly

paragraph: The new **finance** manager should have started by now. The meeting of **finance** ministers lasted for nine hours. He claimed to be an expert in **finance**.
english: management of money and other assets

other.meaning: To conduct, or procure money for, financial operations (verb)
